headline: Qatar Clash
caption:
🇶🇦 Dan Hooker vs. Brian Ortega is official for UFC Qatar on Nov. 21 🔥
Hooker or Ortega? 👇

The UFC finalized the Doha card, with Jiri Prochazka vs. unbeaten Navajo Stirling on top and Aljamain Sterling vs. Kevin Vallejos as the co-main. Kyoji Horiguchi vs. Asu Almabayev is also set. UFC news, fight announcement.

Who takes it?
question: Hooker or Ortega?

v2.story: Hooker vs. Ortega joins Prochazka vs. Stirling on the UFC Qatar card in Doha.
